description: Definitive catalog of everything that expires over time for a T-6A flight instructor under the 3-01/2025 ΔΑΕ, split by experience level (ΑΠ inexperienced / ΕΜΠ experienced). Built to drive a per-instructor currency card with a colour-scale availability view in the FDMS scheduler. English throughout; Greek appears only in `verbatim`, letter-exact as printed.

chapters_used: Ch.4 §§30-35 (PDF 98-99) — evaluations, employment limits, programming priorities
Ch.4 §§37-40 + Πίνακες 9, 11 (PDF 100-102) — semi-annual air programme and reduction bands
Ch.4 §§41-48 + EVENTS table (PDF 103-107) — E-item catalogue and column semantics
Ch.4 §§49-61 + Πίνακας 13 (PDF 108-109) — abstention, renewal chains, crediting, student-flight coverage
Ch.4 §§67-73 (PDF 110-114) — record forms, readiness levels, loss of type availability, re-assignment, monthly exams
Ch.4 §75 Πίνακας 14 + §§76-99 (PDF 115-119) — seminars and recurring trainings
Ch.8 §§18-21, 35-40, 54-56 (PDF 147-155) — test pilots, weapons certification, in-cloud flight
Annex B §§13-17 (PDF 245-246) — flyer categories and experience level

method.process: Two independent research passes (ALPHA and BRAVO) built the catalog separately; this file is the refereed merge. Matched by meaning, then compared field by field. Agreements passed through; every disagreement and every singleton was adjudicated by the referee opening the cited PDF page, with the printed page as the only authority.
method.extraction: The EVENTS table (PDF 105-107) was re-extracted with PyMuPDF word coordinates so that merged cells and column membership are decided by geometry, not by reading order. Verified column centres: ΠΡΟΓΡ. 307.8 | BMC 348.8 | AMC 384.2 | ΑΠ 422.4 | ΕΜΠ 468.4 | merged ΑΠ+ΕΜΠ 446.0 | Τ-6 506.5 | Μ-346 539.9 | ΕΠΑΝ. ΜΕ FMS 578.9 | ΑΝΑΝΕΩΣΗ ΜΕ ΔΙΠΛΗ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ 630.3 | ΘΕΣΗ ΧΕΙΡΙΣΤΗ Α 680.1 / Β 715.4 / Α&Β 750.9.
method.sweep: An independent regex sweep for expiry language (απώλεια/χάνει τη διαθεσιμότητα, τελευταίες N ημέρες, κάθε N ημερολογιακές, αποχή, ισχύ N έτη/μήνες, χρονικό όριο, επαναδιάθεση, ανά έτος) was run over all 253 pages to catch anything both passes missed. It produced the two referee additions listed in dispute D-10; every other hit outside the chapters above concerns students (μαθητές) or radionavigators and is out of scope for an instructor currency card.
method.verbatim_fidelity: `verbatim` reproduces the source letter-exact, including its own inconsistencies — e.g. the source alternates the Greek «ΝΑΙ» and the Latin-N «NAI» inside the same table column, and prints «tοuch» with a Greek omicron in §58. EVENTS rows are transcribed cell by cell with the column labels supplied from the printed header, because a linear text dump of a table row is not interpretable.
method.project_law: T-6 only: rows ticked exclusively under Μ-346 are excluded; where a provision splits by type the T-6 branch is kept with a flag. Numbers exactly as printed — never inferred, never converted (periods printed in years or months stay null in validity_days with the printed period recorded in `printed_period` / `printed_as`). Ambiguities are flagged, never silently resolved.

disputes.topic: Demo restoration — one record or three
disputes.alpha: Separate records for the §18 grace band (15-30 days) and the §20 programme (beyond 30 days), plus the §6 tenure limit.
disputes.bravo: Folded both restoration paths into the renewal_notes of demo-500ft-currency; no tenure record.

disputes.topic: Scope note on the trainee abstention rules (Ch.3 §§65-66)
disputes.alpha: Included both, flagged as applying to εκπαιδευόμενοι and «not to maintenance-stage instructors, who are governed by §70».
disputes.bravo: Not present in the delivered payload (see the truncation caveat in agreement_stats).
disputes.page: PDF 245, Annex B §13: «Εκπαιδευόμενος: Είναι ο Αξιωματικός που εκπαιδεύεται στη ΜΕΑΕ/ΣΜΕΤ για να ορισθεί Εκπαιδευτής ή για να διατεθεί ή επαναδιατεθεί στον τύπο.»

disputes.topic: Two records found by neither research pass (referee additions)
disputes.page: PDF 99, Ch.4 §35β: «Τις ανάγκες προγραμματισμού (επικείμενη λήξη του Εκπαιδευτή στην άσκηση, κλπ)» — impending expiry as a printed input to daily programming and seat allocation. PDF 245, Annex B §§14-15: the posted (ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΜΕΝΟΣ) vs attached (ΠΡΟΣΚΟΛΛΗΜΕΝΟΣ) definition, including the attached groups for whom BMC or type availability is MANDATORY.
disputes.ruling: Both ADDED, each marked «REFEREE ADDITION» in its flags. Found by an independent regex sweep of all 253 pages for expiry language. §35 is the only place in the 3-01 that names impending expiry as a scheduling driver — directly load-bearing for this feature. Annex B §§14-15 is needed to read Tables 6 and 9 correctly, since posted/attached is a different axis from inexperienced/experienced.

open_flags: Ε-4 count for the in-cloud recency: the EVENTS note (1) on PDF 107 requires 2 special exercises Ε-4 in the last 60 days, while Ch.8 §54γ on PDF 155 requires 3 for the same permission. Both verified verbatim by the referee; the 60-day window is identical in both places. UNIT RULING NEEDED.

Ε-7 versus Table 13: the EVENTS type column ticks Ε-7 only under Μ-346, yet Table 13 lists Ε-7 in all four Phase II (T-6) categories and §56 assumes a rear-seat/front-seat landing distinction on any type. Ε-7 is excluded from the item list per project law. UNIT RULING NEEDED before a scheduler treats it as a live T-6 currency.

The «--» printed in the ΑΠ column of Ε-1γ (FCF) and Ε-1δ (DEMO) is nowhere defined by the source and is NOT the blank that §48γ maps to «availability retained forever». Read literally it means inexperienced flyers are not eligible, which is consistent with the Test Pilot criteria of Ch.8 §18, but the source does not say so. UNIT RULING NEEDED.
Ch.5 §17 prints the 15-day demo currency with no experience split while the EVENTS row Ε-1δ prints «--» / 15. Whether an inexperienced instructor may hold the demo currency at all is unresolved.

Π.ΠΔΟ rating validity and the Tactical / Τ-Α evaluation time limits gate combat-ready status via §69δ but carry NO day count in the 3-01 — they are set by KPA Β-6/ΓΕΑ. THE CURRENCY CARD CANNOT BE COMPLETED FROM THIS DOCUMENT ALONE.

Every Table 14 validity is printed as a period word (Ετήσια, Τριμηνιαία, 3-ετής) and §§83/85/93 as «once per year» / «3 years» / «one year». No day counts were inferred; validity_days is null with the printed period recorded. A project ruling is needed on how to convert them for a colour scale.

§70 gives the maintenance-stage loss threshold as 180 days for inexperienced flyers but «πάνω από 1 έτος» for experienced — a units mismatch inside one paragraph. No conversion made; the experienced branch needs a project ruling.
Table 11 leaves calendar day 166 unassigned: the bands run to 136-165 and resume at «Πάνω από 166» (from 167). Reproduced as printed.

The BMC column carries exactly ONE tick in the whole EVENTS table (the day landing), so §69δ(3) reduces in practice to a single currency. This may be a source omission rather than intent. UNIT RULING RECOMMENDED.

Ε-40 and Ε-49Γ are ticked Τ-6 ONLY yet carry ΑΝΑΝΕΩΣΗ ΜΕ ΔΙΠΛΗ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ = ΝΑΙ, which by §48στ means renewal by flying the 2nd type — an event executable only on the T-6 cannot be renewed on the Μ-346. Recorded as printed.

Ε-32 (BFM) is renewed automatically by Ε-33 (ACM) under §60, but Ε-33 is ticked Μ-346 only, so the chain is unreachable for a single-type T-6 instructor and applies only to dual-availability flyers. The source does not state this.
Note (3) declares Ε-22 and Ε-23 not executed, yet both rows still carry a ΠΡΟΓΡ. = ΝΑΙ tick. Printed inconsistency.
Ε-1γ: the EVENTS table ticks ΕΠΑΝ. ΜΕ FMS across both type columns while Annex A §10 grants the FMS option for the Μ-346 only. Unresolved.
Whether the «requirements are minima» sentence (§25) extends from the F/S subsection to the Table 9 air sorties. No equivalent sentence exists in §§28-40; extending it would be an extrapolation.

The §40 reduction is permissive («δύνανται να μειωθούν»), not automatic, and reduces the SEMI-ANNUAL quotas only — it does not extend any day-count currency. A scheduler must treat it as a decision, not a computation.
No definition of «Άπειρος» (inexperienced) is printed anywhere in the 3-01 — Annex B §17 defines only «Έμπειρος», and inexperienced is the complement by implication.

Stale internal cross-references: §48β points to «παράγραφος 70» for the readiness levels (actually §69); §69β/γ/δ point to «παράγραφος 49» for the EVENTS table (actually §48); §83 points to «Παρ. 76» for re-servicing (the PDO seminar paragraph). None affects a value, but citations generated from the document text will be wrong.
The 90-day limit for display manoeuvres above 1000 ft AGL (Ch.5 §19) has no printed restoration path — §§18 and 20 are written for the 500 ft currency and themselves rely on 1000/2000/5000 ft flying.

items.verbatim: 49. Οι Ιπτάμενοι οι οποίοι έχουν αποχή από πτήσεις, (πάνω από 45 ημέρες οι έμπειροι και 30 ημέρες οι άπειροι), να εκτελούν 1 έξοδο SIM-1 στο F/S οι έμπειροι και 2 οι άπειροι, πριν από την επόμενη πτήση αέρος. Σε περίπτωση αδυναμίας εφαρμογής της ανωτέρω πρόβλεψης, η Μονάδα να ζητά «κατ’ εξαίρεση» έγκριση προγραμματισμού του συγκεκριμένου Ιπταμένου από τη ΔΑΕ/Β6.
flags: The threshold is «πάνω από» (strictly greater than) 45/30 days — day 45 exactly does not trigger it for an experienced instructor.

items.name: Day-flying recency required before a night flight

validity_days.note: maximum permitted abstention from DAY flying in order to be programmed for a night flight

items.renewal_notes: Reset by flying any day flight. Applies on top of the night-landing currency — an in-date night landing does not substitute for it.
items.lapse_consequence: The instructor cannot be programmed for a night flight until he flies a day flight; consequently the night-landing currency and every night event (and the AMC characterisation depending on them) become unreachable.

items.verbatim: 50. Προκειμένου ένας Εκπαιδευτής να ιπταθεί νυχτερινή πτήση, θα πρέπει να μην έχει αποχή από τις ημερήσιες πτήσεις για χρονικό διάστημα μεγαλύτερο των 10 ημερών για τους Άπειρους και 15 ημερών για τους Έμπειρους.

items.name: In-cloud (IMC) flight recency — 60-day rolling window

validity_days.note: both provisions print a single 60-day window with no experience split

renews: 1 PDO flight in the last 60 days
1 night flight in the last 60 days
E-4 IFR approaches in the last 60 days (2 per Ch.4 EVENTS note 1 / 3 per Ch.8 §54γ)
items.renewal_notes: Rolling 60-day window satisfied by ANY ONE of: 1 PDO (instrument) flight, OR 1 night flight, OR the Ε-4 IFR-approach option. Renewable in the FMS (Ε-3 carries ν in the ΕΠΑΝ. ΜΕ FMS column). Two further standing prerequisites do not run on this clock: a valid Π.ΠΔΟ rating and in-cloud certification (Ch.8 §54α, §54β).
items.lapse_consequence: The instructor may not fly inside cloud — neither with a student or trainee nor on maintenance-stage sorties. All IMC-dependent work becomes unavailable.
items.bmc_amc: No BMC/AMC mark on Ε-3; gates IMC employment. Tied to the Π.ΠΔΟ rating, which does gate readiness via §69δ(1).

Προκειμένου οι Εκπαιδευτές να ιπταθούν (με μαθητή / εκπαιδευόμενο ή στο στάδιο Συντήρησης) μέσα στα νέφη, πρέπει να πληρούν τις παρακάτω προϋποθέσεις: α. Να έχουν σε ισχύ Π. ΠΔΟ. β. Να είναι πιστοποιημένοι στην πτήση μέσα στα νέφη. γ. Τις τελευταίες 60 ημέρες να έχουν πετάξει 1 πτήση ΠΔΟ ή 1 νυκτερινή πτήση ή να έχουν εκτελέσει 3 Ειδικές Ασκήσεις Ε-4.

The 60-day window itself is identical in both places; only the Ε-4 count differs. Not resolved — unit ruling needed.

validity_days.experienced_printed: πάνω από 1 έτος — more than 1 year; the source prints a period in years, NOT a day count. 365 is not printed and is deliberately not inferred.
validity_days.note: the number is the abstention threshold ABOVE which type availability is lost

items.renewal_notes: The clock is flying abstention and is reset by flying. Once lost, availability is regained only through the formal re-assignment training at the MEAE/ΣΜΕΤ (§71). All re-assignments are flown as co-pilot sorties with an available instructor in the rear seat (§51).

items.verbatim: 70. Απώλεια Διαθεσιμότητας — Ιπτάμενος στη φάση τη συντήρησης χάνει την «Διαθεσιμότητά του στον τύπο» του Α/Φ της ΜΕΑ, όταν έχει αποχή από τις πτήσεις πάνω από: α. 180 ημέρες για άπειρους Ιπταμένους, β. πάνω από 1 έτος για έμπειρους Ιπταμένους.
flags: Units mismatch inside one paragraph: the inexperienced threshold is printed in days (180) and the experienced one in years («πάνω από 1 έτος»). No conversion made — the scheduler needs a project ruling on how to evaluate the experienced branch.

items.name: Type re-assignment programme after loss of availability

validity_days.note: a restoration programme, not a window

items.renewal_notes: Delivered at the MEAE/ΣΜΕΤ, scaled by experience and length of abstention. EXPERIENCED 1-2 years: abbreviated systems course at the ΜΕΑΕ/ΣΕΤ; GBTS check on normal and emergency procedures; 50-question closed-book systems exam; at least 15% of the ΜΕΤ+ΕΕΠ air programme (base percentage at the MEAE Commander's discretion, according to the abstention and experience of the returning flyer); at least 25% of the GBTS programme plus a proportionate ground programme. EXPERIENCED over 2 years: abbreviated course; GBTS checks; 50-question systems + 50-question professional + 25-question open-book exams; at least 15% of the air programme increased by 5% per extra year of abstention beyond 2 years, up to 30%, at the Unit's discretion; 50% of the GBTS sorties. INEXPERIENCED 180 days to 1 year: items (α), (β), (γ) of the 1-2 year tier plus at least 15% air at the MEAE Commander's discretion and at least 25% GBTS. INEXPERIENCED over 1 year: abbreviated course; normal and emergency procedures check in the F/S or GBTS plus a 100-question closed-book systems exam; 20% of the air programme increased by at least 10% per year of abstention beyond one year, up to 50%, at the Unit's discretion; 50% of the GBTS sorties. Exception: rating «Α» holders posted to positions of responsibility may have the ΜΕΤ/ΕΕΠ programme reduced further on Unit recommendation.
items.lapse_consequence: Until completion the instructor stays unavailable on the type. On completion the MEA submits a Re-assignment Completion Report and requests approval to employ him; the report also goes to DAE when a rating extension is involved.
items.bmc_amc: Restores type availability; BMC/AMC then rebuild through the E-item currencies and ΠΡ completion.
items.verbatim: 71. Επαναδιάθεση στον Τύπο του Α/Φ — Η εκπαίδευση για την επαναδιάθεση στον τύπο, παρέχεται στα αντίστοιχα ΣΜΕΤ της ΜΕΑΕ. [...] (δ) Εκτελούν τουλάχιστον το 15% του προβλεπόμενου προγράμματος Αέρος των Σταδίων ΜΕΤ και ΕΕΠ (Εκπαιδευτές), κατά την κρίση του Διοικητή ΜΕΑΕ και ανάλογα με την αποχή και την εμπειρία του επαναδιατιθέμενου. [...] προσαυξανόμενο κατά 5% για κάθε επιπλέον έτος αποχής πάνω από τα 2 έτη και μέχρι 30%, κατά την κρίση της Μονάδας. [...] (γ) Εκτελούν το 20% του προβλεπόμενου προγράμματος αέρος του Σταδίου ΜET και ΕΕΠ (Εκπαιδευτές), προσαυξανόμενο τουλάχιστον κατά 10% για κάθε έτος αποχής πάνω από το ένα έτος και μέχρι 50%, κατά την κρίση της Μονάδας. [...] (ε) Κατ’ εξαίρεση για Ιπταμένους κατόχους Πτυχίου «Α» που τοποθετούνται σε θέσεις ευθύνης, το πρόγραμμα σταδίων ΜΕΤ και ΕΕΠ, δύναται να μειωθεί περαιτέρω, μετά από εισήγηση της Μονάδας.

items.renewal_notes: Per flyer per semester on the T-6A: 6 sorties / 7.2 hours for POSTED instructors, 3 sorties / 3.6 hours for ATTACHED instructors; average sortie duration 1.2 h. validity_days.note: not a validity — the definition that decides WHICH validity column applies

items.renewal_notes: An instructor is EXPERIENCED (ΕΜΠ) if any ONE of four cases holds: (α) 600 h on the squadron type as instructor with no previous fighter experience; (β) 1000 h grand total of which 250 h on the squadron type as flight instructor; (γ) 300 h as pilot-in-command on fighters or other jet/turboprop trainers plus 250 h on the squadron type as instructor — and if he has fewer than 300 h of combat-type, the squadron hours increase by 2 for every 1 hour short of 300; (δ) 150 h on the squadron type as instructor when he was previously characterised experienced on fighters or an experienced instructor on jet/turboprop aircraft.
items.lapse_consequence: Not applicable — a status, not a currency. Until the instructor meets one of the four cases he is treated as inexperienced (ΑΠ) and every ΑΠ column in this catalog applies to him.

items.verbatim: Επίπεδο Εμπειρίας Ιπταμένων — 17. Έμπειρος: Χαρακτηρίζεται ο Εκπαιδευτής ο οποίος ανήκει σε μία από τις παρακάτω περιπτώσεις: α. 600 ώρες στον τύπο της Μοίρας ως Εκπαιδευτής, χωρίς προηγούμενη εμπειρία σε μαχητικά Α/Φ. β. 1.000 ώρες Γενικό Σύνολο, από τις οποίες 250 ώρες στον τύπο της Μοίρας ως Εκπαιδευτής Πτήσεων. γ. 300 ώρες ως Κυβερνήτης σε μαχητικά ή άλλου τύπου εκπαιδευτικά Α/Φ jet ή Turboprop και 250 ώρες στον τύπο της Μοίρας ως Εκπαιδευτής. Σε περίπτωση που έχει λιγότερες από 300 ώρες πολεμικού τύπου, οι ώρες της Μοίρας θα αυξάνονται κατά 2 για κάθε 1 ώρα που υπολείπεται από τις 300 πολεμικού ή άλλου τύπου εκπαιδευτικού Α/Φ jet ή Turboprop. δ. 150 ώρες στον τύπο της Μοίρας ως Εκπαιδευτής, όταν στο παρελθόν έχει χαρακτηρισθεί ως έμπειρος σε μαχητικά Α/Φ ή έμπειρος εκπαιδευτής σε Α/Φ jet ή Turboprop.

items.name: E-item execution, crediting and the 25% non-akin time rule

validity_days.note: crediting rules, not a window

items.renewal_notes: E items may be flown within ANY main exercise (Σ) provided the aircraft configuration and the flying area permit and the restrictions of EE 3-18/ΔΑΕ are kept (§42). The Special Instructions of each Σ analysis list the akin E exercises; if the E is NOT akin to the Σ being flown, the time given to it may not exceed 25% of total sortie time (§43). An E that by its nature consumes a large part or all of a sortie is charged to the nearest akin main exercise (Σ) as well as to the corresponding E (§44). Planned E items are briefed pre-flight, logged in the flight log and archived for flying-task control (§45). Covering the minimum E requirements is the parallel responsibility of the flyer himself and of the squadron (§46). For any Event with a corresponding ΠΡ module, the instructor must have completed that ΠΡ training before he may execute it (§47).
items.lapse_consequence: An E flown outside these rules cannot be credited, so the underlying currency does not renew.

items.renewal_notes: During maintenance-stage training the squadron may, through the daily programme, fix the seat each instructor will occupy in the cockpit, taking into account: (α) seniority among the flyers; (β) THE PROGRAMMING NEEDS — the impending expiry of the instructor in the exercise, etc.; (γ) re-assignment in a specific exercise or Event (E); (δ) the difference between the front and rear seat. items.name: Advanced exercises (ΠΡ) — entry gate and overall completion deadline

validity_days.printed_period: εντός 7 μηνών — within 7 months of the start; printed in months, not days

items.renewal_notes: ΠΡ training may begin only after the instructor completes 10 sorties following his posting to the squadron (except the ΠΡ modules that require a formation-lead title) and finishes according to experience, performance and the squadron's other requirements (§7). Ground training precedes flying and comprises theory plus one F/S sortie per module (§10). The whole ΠΡ programme completes within 7 months of its start, with the same formation-lead exception (§11). Instructors used for ΠΡ training must be at least Four-ship Leaders and available in the exercises concerned (§13). In the last sortie of each module a certification for that ΠΡ is performed and recorded in the grade sheet; the certification flight is flown by the Flight Commander, the Training Officer (Α.Ε.), the Squadron Commander or the Unit Τ-Α Officer (§14). After initial assignment, flyers retain availability in these exercises through the semi-annual training programmes (§6).
items.lapse_consequence: A completion deadline for the programme, not a recurring currency.
items.bmc_amc: ΠΡ-1 completion is the BMC gate; completing the whole ΠΡ set is the AMC gate.
